description_en: Queries jobs under a specified node
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定任务下的作业
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-task --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --task-id MSnT9000q010101 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryTask

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If no ID value is displayed for a public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the job under the node
parameters.name: task_id
